crossRefs.note: His feet will stand in that day on the Mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east; and the Mount of Olives…
When they came near to Jerusalem, and came to Bethsphage, to the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,
As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be?…
When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is…
They worshiped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,
He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.

people.name: Jerusalem

people.name: Olives_Mount
people.line: A mountain ridge east of Jerusalem

translations.web: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day’s journey away.
translations.bsb: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives, which is near the city, a Sabbath day’s journey away.
translations.kjv: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day's journey.
translations.asv: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is nigh unto Jerusalem, a Sabbath day's journey off.
